producers.label: LSTM
producers.note: Every published above-threshold candidate, enriched with forward returns and the model's own exit window.

producers.label: Intrinsic
producers.note: Needs development. Intrinsic publishes a discount-to-value score rather than a horizon candidate set, so its row set and its outcomes have to be defined before this can measure anything.

producers.label: Foundry
producers.note: Needs development. Foundry rows are one gated decision per ticker per trading day over an event stream, so the vectors worth slicing are the gate's inputs, not a score file's columns.
